text:
ola: heads up — deploy-bot detected a canary regression in eu-south after values-sync. ~25% 502s on canary. change: connectionPool.size bumped from 120 -> 4000 by automated job. do we hotpatch values, pin chart, or full rollback?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary-failure eu-south - 6/24 pods failing healthcheck (502) - change-id: values-sync-2024-08-12 - rc: rc-2024-08-12-7

marco: only eu-south canary affected so far. staging and prod look fine. dashboards show spike in queued connections and upstream 502s right after prefix cache misses.

anya: quick plan: 1) apply a namespace-scoped canary override to revert connectionPool.size -> 120, 2) add a promotion hold, 3) pin the chart for this release candidate until we validate. avoid touching global chart repo unless override doesn't help.

ola: agree. can someone run the override and restart the canary? include the helm/patch snippet in thread so release notes capture it.

marco: running this now:

```
# create canary-only override configmap and restart
kubectl -n eu-south create configmap svc-canary-values --from-literal=connectionPool.size=120 --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n eu-south rollout restart deploy/myservice-canary
```

release-bot: creating ticket INF-5123; placing promotion hold for rc-2024-08-12-7; recording pin request for myservice-chart v6.2.1 -> v6.2.0.

deploy-bot: action -> applied canary override; promotion hold set; pinned candidate chart v6.2.1 -> v6.2.0 for promotion gating; ticket INF-5123.

anya: ola, please add a short blurb to release-notes: "Temporary revert: connectionPool.size reverted to 120 for eu-south canary. Promotion on hold pending 30m stable health. Values-sync exempted for this chart family until follow-up." include ticket #INF-5123.

ola: done. added note and flagged infra for values-sync exemption. also added a checklist for potential next steps: hotpatch values, small chart patch fixing default, or full RC rollback + postmortem.

marco: override applied, restart triggered. monitoring for 20m. will post counts of 502s and restart events. :hourglass:

anya: if canary stabilizes in 20-30m we unhold and keep chart pin for one promotion cycle so we can ship a targeted chart patch with adjusted defaults. if instability continues, escalate to rollback RC and schedule a short blameless review.

ola: one more note — if we do a chart rollback, prefer a rollback that preserves the values overlay but reverts chart image or hooks. in other words, prefer chart-only rollback vs wiping values unless necessary.

marco: noted. will watch logs and CPU/conn metrics. posting update in 20m. :eyes:
